svg.title: Co-op, one feature at a time
svg.desc: 55 released, 29 experimental, 9 planned. Each segment is one named feature. Development features are not included in the current download. Counts and percentages describe this inventory, not overall completion.
svg.text: Co-op, one feature at a time
Early Beta 19 - modular construction and quest fixes
One segment = one feature. See the list for its scope.

rect.title: Host a Steam lobby: Released. Open a lobby from the Multiplayer window.
Join a lobby: Released. Join the Host and receive the selected world.
Create a shared world: Released. The Host uses the original new-world wizard while the other player waits.
Send session messages: Released. Send and read basic messages in the Multiplayer window.
Pause together: Released. Pause or resume the shared world from either player.
Change game speed: Released. Keep both players on the same selected simulation speed.
Place a building: Released. Place supported buildings with shared costs.
Move a building: Released. Move a supported building and preserve its shared identity.
Remove a building: Released. Remove a supported building and share its refund.
Copy a building: Released. Copy supported buildings, including after placement and undo/redo.
Undo and redo building placement: Released. Restore the building and scenery cleared by its placement.
Place individual scenery: Released. Place a supported scenery object with shared costs.
Move individual scenery: Released. Move one scenery object with both players seeing the same pose.
Remove individual scenery: Released. Remove one selected scenery object and share its refund.
Copy individual scenery: Released. Create a shared copy with its own identity.
Group scenery: Released. Group selected scenery objects together.
Copy a scenery group: Released. Copy the group and its member objects.
Ungroup scenery: Released. Ungroup either the original group or its copy.
Undo and redo grouping: Released. Restore group membership and names through shared history.
Erase one scenery object: Released. Use one eraser click and share the refund. Held strokes and large brushes are separate work.
Erase with held and large brushes: Planned. Extend the confirmed single-click eraser scope.
Buy a region: Released. Share the region purchase and cost.
Change a region biome: Released. Share supported biome-style changes.
Change region levels: Released. Share the selected region level range.
Sell a region: Experimental. Share the ownership change and its financial effects.
Paint forest terrain: Released. Share a completed forest-terrain stamp.
Build a road: Released. Place a road, including a connection to an existing endpoint.
Remove a road: Released. Remove a road and share its refund.
Paint other terrain styles: Experimental. Share the other active terrain-paint styles.
Build and remove walls: Experimental. Share the active wall tool and its changes.
Draw and edit a district: Experimental. Share district shape, height and title placement.
Place a Class Trainer: Released. Place a Class Trainer in the shared world.
Move a Class Trainer: Released. Move an existing Class Trainer.
Remove a Class Trainer: Released. Remove an existing Class Trainer.
Place a Quest Giver: Released. Place a Quest Giver in the shared world.
Move a Quest Giver: Released. Move an existing Quest Giver.
Remove a Quest Giver: Released. Remove an existing Quest Giver.
Edit NPC properties: Experimental. Share the offered NPC property controls and affected quest references.
Place an Elite monster: Released. Place an individual Elite monster while paused.
Move an Elite monster: Released. Move an individual Elite monster while paused.
Remove an Elite monster: Released. Remove an individual Elite monster while paused.
Edit a monster zone: Experimental. Share zone shape, population settings and resets.
Share moving monster state: Experimental. Publish the Host's current moving actor state. This does not claim complete combat, respawn, Boss or visitor simulation.
Share the full running simulation: Planned. Cover interacting combat, quests, economy and lifecycle behavior together.
Create a quest: Released. Add a quest to a supported Quest Giver.
Remove a quest: Released. Remove a supported authored quest.
Rename a quest: Released. Share changes to its title.
Change quest counts: Released. Share changes to the required count.
Change quest rewards: Released. Share XP, gold and default-reward changes.
Choose a building destination: Released. Use a supported building, including a modular building, as the quest destination on both players.
Choose an NPC destination: Released. Use a supported NPC as the quest destination.
Research Bridges: Released. Start Bridges research, assign workers and unlock it together.
Place a modular prefab: Released. Place a normal prefab with its selected theme. Other theme variants are not confirmed.
Add a modular block: Released. Use the normal block-adding tool.
Remove a modular block: Released. Use the left-click block-removal tool.
Add a modular entrance: Released. Use the normal entrance-adding tool.
Remove a modular entrance: Released. Use the normal entrance-removal tool.
Undo a modular layout edit: Released. The Client undoes a shared layout change.
Redo a modular layout edit: Released. The Host redoes that shared layout change.

Progress modular construction: Experimental. Host developers can start construction, and the Client receives the current construction state. Full construction completion and all staff interactions remain experimental.
Remove a block with right-click: Experimental. Use right-click in block-building mode to request a shared removal.
Change an existing building theme: Planned. Confirm separate theme editing and additional theme variants.
Continue a saved world: Released. Continue together from the Host's supported saved world.
Save a modular world: Released. Save the current world through the original game operation.
Reload a modular world: Released. Load the saved modular world on the Host.
Share the loaded modular world: Released. Load it on a Client that has already joined. This does not cover a later join.
Edit a loaded modular building: Released. Continue editing after the save assigns new object identities.
Join an already running world later: Planned. Receive current state and continue without missing or repeating edits.

Rejoin after a disconnect: Planned. Leaving and rejoining without closing the game, followed by scenery placement, works in the current two-player scope. Recovery after a Client restart or connection loss remains unconfirmed.
Place and remove a Dungeon portal: Experimental. Keep the exterior building, Dungeon identity and related references together.
Open and close Dungeon cells: Experimental. Share layout-cell edits and their history.
Paint Dungeon floors: Experimental. Share the offered Dungeon paint and theme controls.
Place Dungeon doors: Experimental. Share a door and its layout references.
Place Dungeon keys: Experimental. Preserve the shared key-to-door relationship.
Place Dungeon treasure: Experimental. Share treasure placement and references.
Change Dungeon lighting: Experimental. Share authored light and palette settings.
Configure Dungeon instances: Experimental. Share the offered instance configuration values. Creation, removal, entering and party lifecycles are not included in this claim.
Create and copy character types: Experimental. Share committed character-type creation, copy and variant membership commands. This does not claim every editor operation.
Edit a character costume: Experimental. Share committed model, body, color and animation choices.
Import a character PNG card: Experimental. Share a character-definition import through the original image-loading operation. This is not a world or map import.
Edit abilities: Experimental. Share offered ability costs, effects and membership changes.
Edit Boss phases: Experimental. Share offered phase and character-stat controls.
Place server-network nodes: Experimental. Share the offered server-network node operations.
Connect server-network cables: Experimental. Share endpoints, waypoints and connection removal.
Change game fees: Experimental. Share purchase, subscription and offered service prices.
Take and repay loans: Experimental. Share the loan state and resulting money changes.
Run advertising campaigns: Experimental. Share campaigns, budgets and financial effects.
Manage developers and Game Masters: Experimental. Share the implemented staff-assignment and job-state commands. This does not claim the whole staff simulation.
Publish MMO updates: Experimental. Share the implemented release-state and committed-project commands. This does not claim every MMO-update workflow.
Build with four players: Planned. Confirm the same gameplay with four participants.
Play in larger worlds: Planned. Confirm gameplay and save behavior beyond the small-world scope.
Keep large sessions responsive: Planned. Confirm performance under representative multiplayer load.
Play across separate Steam accounts: Planned. Complete the online acceptance with separate accounts and machines.

svg.text: This is feature progress, not a project completion score.
Experimental features are included in this download.
